title: Auditory Cortex Mapping Dataset
description: A single-subject MEG and structural MRI dataset collected to demonstrate a MEG-based auditory cortex mapping technique. The participant passively listened binaurally to 1795 iso-intensity pure tones spanning 100 Hz to about 21.5 kHz in quarter-octave steps, while MEG was recorded on a CTF 275 system. The dataset also includes empty-room recordings, head shape digitization, and a 1.5T anatomical MRI processed with FreeSurfer.
methods_description: MEG was recorded with a CTF 275 system at 12000 Hz, with a 3000 Hz anti-aliasing low-pass filter and 3rd order gradient compensation. The run lasted about 653 s. Pure tones were presented through intra-aural earphones at an average rate of 3 Hz with randomized inter-stimulus intervals, generated with the Matlab Psychophysics toolbox. ECG and EOG were recorded and a trigger channel marked stimulus times. Head shape and fiducials were digitized with a Polhemus Fastrak. Anatomy was acquired with a 1.5T MRI and processed with FreeSurfer 5.3. Empty-room recordings were also acquired.
